caption: The drawing shows a cylindrical wooden object resembling a stamp or mold, positioned at an angle so that the open circular face is visible. The cylindrical body is rendered in shades of light and medium brown, indicating a wood texture with visible grain lines. At one end of the object, there is a rounded handle featuring darker, curved grain patterns. The flat circular face of the object displays a carved design consisting of a symmetrical leaf with three pairs of lateral leaflets, extending from a central stem, and an oval shape with a curved stem or vine below the leaf. The background is plain and off-white, with small scattered brown spots. The drawing uses detailed shading to indicate light and depth on the object, and the artist’s signature, "Wilbur M. Rice," is written at the lower right corner.
title: Butter Mold
